programme.title: Lost Cities Revealed with Albert Lin
programme.desc: Albert Lin explores ancient cities and learns the secrets of ancient builders.The respected scientist completed, among others:a search expedition for Genghis Khan's tomb in Mongolia.The researcher once again sets out on an extraordinary mission.Viewers will be able to watch him wander through the jungle, trying to find objects related to the Mayan settlement.As always, it is equipped with modern devices that allow you to scan the surroundings.The National Geographic envoy is not afraid of risk.He will break through untouched areas, cross wild rivers and slide down a rope into a giant cave.He will undertake all these daring feats to solve another mystery from the past Albert Lin is an engineer and researcher at the University of California.He gained worldwide fame as a traveler and explorer who uses the latest technological achievements during his escapades.He reaches places inaccessible to average people - such as caves or hidden ruins of monumental buildings.His bionic leg prosthesis does not prevent him from performing feats requiring high physical fitness.The new series with his participation is a record of a fascinating expedition to ancient cities.Its motto is that history still hides many secrets from archaeologists that can revise our view of the past.Secrets of the Mayan Cradle Palenque is an archaeological site in Mexico.Here lived the people who built, among other things, the Temple of Inscriptions built on a step pyramid.Its discovery became a sensation, but this extraordinary place is still full of secrets.Modern technology allows you to explore the jungle, the bottom of a water-filled crater or the interior of a mountain in a way that was inaccessible to archaeologists of the past.Viewers will, among other things, witness Albert Lin's exciting descent into an underground cave.They will see what a traveler will discover in a place considered sacred.
